resources.string: Choose a Doubao recognition model directly. Streaming models show text as you speak and need a stable network. Standard file recognition uploads the full recording after you stop and is more accurate. Turbo file recognition also uploads after you stop and is faster. Does not change settings other than regular recognition.

Choose a Doubao recognition model directly:
 1. Streaming speech recognition 2.0 / 1.0: text appears as you speak, with lower start/end latency; needs a stable network.
 2. Standard file recognition 2.0 / 1.0 (submit/query): uploads the full recording after you stop; more accurate.
 3. Turbo file recognition 1.0 (flash): uploads after you stop; faster.
Choose standard or turbo file recognition under Recognition model. The full recording is uploaded after you stop.
This mode is now selected as streaming speech recognition 1.0 or 2.0 under Recognition model. Text appears as you speak; a stable network is required.
Outputs raw recognition results without additional processing.
Enables semantic smoothing to automatically optimize expression and formatting of recognition results. Experimental feature.
The recording is recognized continuously without automatic segmentation based on speech and pauses.
The recording is automatically segmented based on speech and pauses, which may make long results easier to read. Results depend on the audio and provider.
Uses only the first-pass streaming result. Text returns directly, without a second correction pass.
The provider performs a second correction pass on the streaming result. Final text may improve, but interim text may change.
Choose turbo file recognition 1.0 under Recognition model. Uploads after you stop and is faster.
Choose standard file recognition 1.0 or 2.0 under Recognition model. Uploads the full recording after you stop (submit/query) and is more accurate.
Choose the matching 1.0 model under Recognition model.
Choose the matching 2.0 model under Recognition model. Better accuracy and broader language support.
Uses the classic App Key / Access Key authentication.
Uses the newer X-Api-Key authentication. Choose the method that matches your Volcano Engine console credentials.
